changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [utility].[ArtifactAssetParent] as select O.ID as AssetID, S.ID as ParentAssetID from dbo.Asset S inner join dbo.[Intersect] I on I.SubjectAssetID = S.ID inner join dbo.IntersectType AS T ON T.ID = I.IntersectTypeID inner join dbo.[Predicate] AS P ON P.ID = T.PredicateID and P.Type in (3, 4) Inner Join dbo.Asset O on O.ID = I.ObjectAssetID
changeSet.rollback: create or alter view [utility].[ArtifactAssetParent] WITH SCHEMABINDING AS select O.ID as AssetID, S.ID as ParentAssetID from dbo.Asset S inner join dbo.[Intersect] I on I.Subject = S.Object and I.SubjectID = S.ObjectID inner join dbo.IntersectType AS T ON T.ID = I.IntersectTypeID inner join dbo.[Predicate] AS P ON P.ID = T.PredicateID and P.Type in (3, 4) Inner Join dbo.Asset O on O.Object = I.Object and O.ObjectID = I.ObjectID
